text:
Maya: Quick sync  APAC webinar nudge: focused 3-email cadence for registrants + soft re-engage for non-registrants. Objective: maximize high-quality RSVPs without spiking provider queues.

Zoe: Sounds good. Cohorts I propose: (A) registered but not confirmed, (B) expressed interest (clicked benchmark link), (C) recent signups 0-7d. Keep sample sizes small for tests.

Kit: For subject experiments: short headline vs stat-led. e.g., \"Join live: Redwood benchmark walk-through\" vs \"Median latency 28ms  see how\". Run A/B only on 8k samples per cohort.

Arjun: Localization: use three APAC buckets (AU/NZ, SEA, IN). Format dates local and avoid timezone strings in subject. For IN prefer earlier window to hit morning inboxes.

Sam: Ops: recommend micro-batching with ISP-aware throttle. Canary 4% of total registrants, ramp 15/50/100. Also add a rate limit per provider to protect provider back-pressure.

Maya: Creative: single-column mobile-first template, hero with one CTA (Confirm + Add to calendar) and small secondary link (Watch benchmark). Minimal images.

Zoe: Reminder timing: reminder at 48h for unconfirmed registrants, last-chance 3h before start for those who opened but didn't confirm. For non-registrants, send a single teaser 72h prior.

Kit: Also test CTA copy: \"Add to calendar\" vs \"Confirm spot\" for registered cohort. We'll track click-through and calendar-add events.

Sam: Ops config snippet:
```
campaign: apac-webinar-nudge-v1
canary_pct: 4
ramp_steps: [15,50,100]
isp_throttle: {SendGrid:5000, MailerX:2500}
windows:
  AU_NZ: \"09:00-11:00 +10:00\"
  SEA: \"10:00-12:00 +08:00\"
  IN: \"09:00-10:30 +05:30\"
retry_on_rate_limit: true
```
I'll stage the canary for Thursday morning.

Arjun: We'll also include a small variant for mobile preview text that mentions local time in the preheader. Keep it short.

Zoe: Exclusions: unsubscribed, hard bounces, anyone who RSVP'd in past 30d for a similar webinar. Also exclude internal test accounts.

Maya: Reporting: calendar-add rate, confirm clicks, webinar attendance, deliverability (blocks/bounces). Auto-hold rule: if spam_complaint >0.04% during canary or ISP block_rate >0.5%, pause that ISP.

deliverability-bot: Monitor configured: apac-webinar-nudge-deliv. Alerts: hard_bounce>0.25%, spam_complaint>0.04%, block_rate>0.5%.

Kit: I'll draft subject + preheader variants and share samples. Zoe, can you scope the sample segments?

Zoe: Yes  will export cohort samples and post counts later today.

Sam: Will upload campaign-runner YAML and post link once ready. Canary scheduled after segments are final.

Maya: Owners: Zoe=segments, Kit=copy+tests, Arjun=localization, Sam=ops, Maya=metrics. Call out blockers here. :rocket:
